summary: Quantum BioPharma Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing it reached the midpoint of patient enrollment in an imaging study with Massachusetts General Hospital. The study evaluates a novel PET tracer, [18F]3F4AP, for assessing demyelination in multiple sclerosis. No financial terms, deal structure, or special-situation event was disclosed. The filing is a routine progress update unrelated to any corporate transaction, activist campaign, capital return, or restructuring activity, thus it does not constitute a special situation.
